en: A black‑and‑white image showing a large, ornate brick school building with a tall clock‑tower‑like structure and arched entrance. In front of the building stands a group of schoolboys in early 20th‑century clothing, scattered across a lawn with young trees. Above the entrance, a sign reads "HIGH SCHOOL." The architectural style is late 19th‑century American, with a mix of Romanesque and Victorian details.
